title: Lead I - Software Testing
description:
**Role Description**
 Job Title: Senior QA / Software Testing Engineer
   

  

**Experience Range:** 
 8\+ Years
   

  

**Hiring Location:** 
 \[Specify Location]
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 QA / Software Testing
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **QA / Software Testing professional with 8\+ years of experience** 
 who can independently own end\-to\-end testing activities across projects. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in
 **Manual/Functional Testing, Database Testing with SQL, API Testing, and Defect Management** 
 , along with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
   

  

 The candidate should be comfortable working with distributed
 **onshore and offshore teams** 
 , taking ownership of testing deliverables, and supporting project activities during early morning CST / evening IST working hours when required.
   

  

 Must Have Skills
   

  

* 8\+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Assurance.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Manual and Functional Testing.
* Strong Database Testing experience with SQL.
* Ability to write and execute medium to complex SQL queries.
* Hands\-on experience with Stored Procedures and database validation.
* Strong experience in API Testing.
* Ability to create, execute, maintain, and document comprehensive test cases based on business and technical requirements.
* Strong experience in Defect Management, including defect reporting, tracking, re\-testing, and closure.
* Experience working with Test Case Management tools; Zephyr Enterprise preferred.
* Good understanding of Software Testing Processes and SDLC.
* Experience with JIRA and/or similar defect tracking tools.
* Good understanding of JSON and API response validation.
* Ability to independently own testing activities from test planning through test execution and reporting.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


 Good to Have Skills
   

  

* Performance Testing experience using JMeter.
* API testing experience using Postman.
* Test Automation experience using Katalon Studio, Harness, or similar tools.
* Exposure to automated test execution and CI/CD environments.
* Experience working with Confluence.
* Exposure to automation frameworks and automated regression testing.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Experience working with distributed/global teams.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end QA and testing activities across assigned projects.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and identify appropriate testing scenarios.
* Prepare test plans, test estimates, test scenarios, and test cases.
* Execute functional, regression, integration, and database testing activities.
* Perform SQL\-based database validation, including complex queries and Stored Procedures.
* Perform API testing and validate request/response data, including JSON payloads.
* Log, track, prioritize, re\-test, and close defects in collaboration with development teams.
* Maintain test cases and testing documentation using Zephyr Enterprise or similar tools.
* Prepare and communicate test execution status, defect metrics, risks, and quality reports.
* Coordinate effectively with developers, business analysts, product owners, and project stakeholders.
* Work closely with onshore and offshore teams to ensure timely completion of testing deliverables.
* Proactively investigate issues, ask relevant questions, and identify potential quality risks.
* Support continuous improvement of testing processes, standards, and practices.
* Take ownership of assigned deliverables and ensure testing activities are completed within project timelines.


 Behavioral / Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Self\-motivated with a proactive, go\-getter attitude.
* Strong verbal and written communication.
* Curious and willing to learn the business/domain.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking ability.
* High attention to detail with a strong quality mindset.
* Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively.
* Willingness to ask questions and proactively investigate issues.
* Coachable, adaptable, and open to feedback.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong presentation skills are an added advantage.


 Role Expectations
   

  

 The successful candidate should be capable of independently managing the complete testing lifecycle, including:
   

  

**Test Planning → Estimation → Test Case Preparation → Test Execution → Defect Management → Re\-testing → Test Reporting → Stakeholder Coordination → Closure**
 The candidate should also be comfortable collaborating with distributed/onshore teams and attending meetings during
 **early morning CST / evening IST hours, typically 7:00–10:00 AM CST** 
 , when required.
   

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 A strong
 **functional QA professional** 
 with 8\+ years of experience and proven expertise in
 **Manual/Functional Testing, SQL/Database Testing, and API Testing** 
 . The candidate should demonstrate strong ownership, independence, analytical thinking, communication skills, and willingness to learn the business domain.
   

  

**Skills**
 API Testing, Database Testing, Functional Testing, JSON, Confluence, Zephyr, Postman, Manual Testing, Katalon Studio, SQL, Test Automation

description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting\-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast\-forward your career at Comcast.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Responsible for coordinating and directing the designing, building and overseeing the deployment and operation of technology architecture, solutions and software to capture, manage, store and utilize structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources. Establishes and builds processes and structures based on business and technical requirements to channel data from multiple inputs, route appropriately and store using any combination of distributed (cloud) structures, local databases, and other applicable storage forms as required. Develops technical tools and programming that leverage artificial intelligence, machine learning and big\-data techniques to cleanse, organize and transform data and to maintain, defend and update data structures and integrity on an automated basis. Creates and establishes design standards and assurance processes for software, systems and applications development to ensure compatibility and operability of data connections, flows and storage requirements. Reviews internal and external business and product requirements for data operations and activity and suggests changes and upgrades to systems and storage to accommodate ongoing needs. May manage a team including exempt and non\-exempt employees. Provides subject matter guidance to employees as required. Develops processes and procedures to drive department efficiencies. Assists in development and meeting of departmental budget.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Provide technological leadership in understanding business problems and work with the lead engineers to come up with technical solutions with due consideration to performance, cost, scalability and reliability providing a clear roadmap to implementation
* Inculcate innovation\-mindset in the team by guiding them on the latest technological trends and how they impact the Comcast landscape
* Adopt to changing business and technology needs and ensure that the solutions created leverage the best options available in the market
* Manage a team of data engineers providing and tracking their quarterly and annual goals which are aligned to the organizational goals
* Execute projects in Agile \- participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning and capacity management
* Work with Lead / Sr Engineers to estimate the stories in the backlog during sprint planning
* Assign stories to the team and track the progress in daily standups
* Capture retrospective actions and ensure that the learnings are carried over to the subsequent sprints
* Ensure user tickets are resolved on time with a clear downward trend, repeated incidents are reduced, process optimizations and efficiency opportunities are picked up in every sprint
* Ensure team has clarity on responsibilities and are accountable to them
* Responsible for identifying, coaching, developing, motivating, with technical guidance on software deliverables
* Set continuous improvement targets for the team to achieve operational efficiency and plug technical debts
* Cascade the data and platform strategy supporting the team in upskilling and prepared for the new technology roadmap
* Establish, review and upgrade the development and operational standards \& guidelines to ensure quality of the data assets being deployed
* Resolve conflicting needs across stakeholders coming up with the a win\-win solution
* Effectively collaborate with the dx partners, business users and DevOps teams to manage roadblocks and to support business, product or technical goals
* Set quality, productivity and innovation goals for team thereby developing a driven and motivated team
* Ensure timely communication to the stakeholders and leadership on any outstanding issues / data issues and timeline changes
* Conduct regular 1:1 with team to understand aspirations, challenges and support needed providing opportunities to showcase capabilities and develop new skills.


**Skills And Experience**
* 12\+ years of IT experience
* 6\+ years of experience leading data engineering teams creating solutions in Big Data platforms and AWS
* 3\+ years of experience in building containerized data engineering solutions using Docker and Kubernetes
* Expert\-level knowledge in Agile software development and CI\-CD practices
* Good communication and presentation skills catering to a wide range of target audience starting from IT developers to senior leadership teams
* Strong team player who can shape the future state technical platform and applications

Additionally, Comcast provides best\-in\-class Benefits to eligible employees. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always\-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality \- to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
**Lead Data Engineer**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Lead Data Engineer** to lead the design, development, and optimization of scalable data platforms and pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in data engineering, cloud technologies, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, and distributed data processing.

As a Lead Data Engineer, you will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and business teams to build reliable data solutions that support business intelligence, analytics, and AI/ML initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and development of **scalable, high\-performance data pipelines and data platforms**.
* Design and implement robust **ETL/ELT workflows** for batch and real\-time data processing.
* Develop and optimize data pipelines using **Python, SQL, and distributed data processing frameworks**.
* Design and maintain **data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse architectures**.
* Work with large and complex datasets while ensuring data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Optimize data processing jobs, queries, storage, and infrastructure for performance and cost efficiency.
* Implement data validation, monitoring, logging, and error\-handling mechanisms.
* Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Analysts, Software Engineers, and Product teams to understand data requirements.
* Lead technical discussions, architecture decisions, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
* Mentor and guide junior and mid\-level data engineers.
* Establish and maintain standards for **data governance, security, quality, and documentation**.
* Troubleshoot production data issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Evaluate new data technologies and recommend solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.

**Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

* **6\+ years of experience** in Data Engineering or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in **Python and SQL**.
* Strong experience building **ETL/ELT pipelines** and data processing workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with **Apache Spark / PySpark**.
* Strong understanding of **data warehousing and dimensional modeling**.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems and data engineering architecture.
* Experience with **Git, CI/CD, testing, and deployment practices**.
* Strong understanding of data quality, data governance, and security principles.

**Cloud \& Modern Data Stack**

Experience with one or more cloud platforms:

* **AWS / Azure / GCP**
* Cloud storage and data lake technologies
* Cloud\-based data warehouses
* Containerization using **Docker/Kubernetes**
* Workflow orchestration tools such as **Apache Airflow**
* Streaming technologies such as **Kafka**

Experience with modern data platforms such as **Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent** will be an advantage.

**Good to Have**

* Experience supporting **AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines**.
* Experience with **real\-time data processing and streaming architectures**.
* Knowledge of **DataOps, MLOps, or DevOps practices**.
* Experience with lakehouse architecture.
* Experience working with large\-scale datasets and high\-volume data systems.
* Relevant cloud or data engineering certifications.

**Apply Now**

If you are a passionate Data Engineer with strong technical expertise and leadership experience, we'd love to hear from you!

Pay: ₹1,500,000\.00 \- ₹2,500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Data Engineer III
description:
**Role: Data Engineer III**

**Division: Assessment \& Qualifications Delivery**

**Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India**

**About Pearson Qualifications:** We are the UK's largest awarding body and we are regulated by Ofqual (England), CCEA Accreditation (Northern Ireland) and Qualifications Wales (Wales). We offer academic and vocational qualifications that are globally recognised and benchmarked, with educational excellence rooted in names like Edexcel and BTEC. In 2025, we issued 6\.5 million grades to candidates worldwide.


**About the role**

The Data Engineer is responsible for developing and supporting data integration and transformation solutions across Pearson's enterprise data platforms.


Working within the Data Engineering team, you will develop Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines and SQL\-based transformation logic to move data from operational systems into common data models used by downstream applications.


This is a hands\-on engineering role and would suit someone with strong experience in both Azure Data Factory and SQL database development. You will work closely with Data Modellers, Architects and fellow Data Engineers to deliver reliable, scalable and maintainable data integration solutions.


**About You**

You are a hands\-on Data Engineer with strong experience in Azure Data Factory and SQL database development. You enjoy solving complex data integration problems and are equally comfortable building cloud\-based data pipelines and implementing SQL transformation logic within relational databases.


You have a strong engineering mindset, write clean, maintainable code and are comfortable working within an Agile delivery environment.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain reusable, parameterised Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines following established engineering standards.
* Develop SQL\-based transformation logic to convert source data into target data models using complex queries, stored procedures, views and functions.
* Build and maintain database objects within Azure SQL Managed Instance, Aurora MySQL or PostgreSQL.
* Analyse SQL execution plans and implement query optimisation and indexing strategies to improve database performance.
* Develop automation scripts to support database deployment and operational activities.
* Support database schema changes through GitHub and CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with Data Modellers and Architects to implement agreed data models and transformation logic.
* Support the diagnosis and resolution of issues relating to data pipelines, data transformations and database performance.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
* Produce technical documentation where required.

**Essential Skills \& Experience**

* Strong hands\-on experience developing Azure Data Factory (ADF) pipelines.
* Strong SQL development skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, views and functions.
* Experience developing large\-scale SQL data transformation solutions.
* Experience analysing SQL execution plans and implementing query optimisation techniques.
* Experience implementing indexing strategies and database performance tuning.
* Strong hands\-on database development experience with SQL Server/Azure SQL, PostgreSQL and/or MySQL, with the ability to apply SQL engineering and performance\-tuning skills across different relational database platforms.
* Experience developing ETL/ELT solutions.
* Experience using GitHub or similar version control systems.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**

* Familiarity with DACPAC\-based database deployment.
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks (Python or Scala) or DBT.
* Experience working with Change Data Capture (CDC).
* Experience with AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) or similar database migration technologies.
* Exposure to enterprise data integration or platform\-based environments.
* Azure or AWS certification.

**Job Location and Hours**

The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45 hour week. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires our team to work from their base office 3 times per week.


**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.


Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E\-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.


If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

title: Lead Fabric Data engineer
description:
**Job Summary**  

  



We are looking for an experienced Lead Fabric Data Engineer to design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric for our Industrial Gas project.


The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Factory, Data Warehouse, Spark/PySpark, SQL, and Power BI. You will be responsible for building robust data pipelines, implementing Medallion Architecture, optimizing data processing workloads, and ensuring high\-quality, secure, and reliable data solutions.


You will work closely with architects, business stakeholders, data engineers, and analytics teams to deliver enterprise\-grade data platforms and analytics solutions.


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.
* Build and maintain end\-to\-end data pipelines using Fabric Data Factory, Pipelines, and Dataflows Gen2\.
* Develop data ingestion and transformation processes across structured and semi\-structured data sources.
* Implement Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold) using Fabric Lakehouse.
* Develop and optimize PySpark/Spark notebooks for large\-scale data processing and transformation.
* Design and implement data models and curated datasets for analytics and reporting.
* Develop solutions using Fabric Data Warehouse and T\-SQL for analytical workloads.
* Work with Delta Lake and optimize storage, partitioning, and data processing strategies.
* Implement incremental data loads, slowly changing dimensions, data quality checks, and error\-handling frameworks.
* Integrate data from multiple sources including Azure, SQL Server, APIs, files, and legacy data platforms.
* Optimize pipeline performance, Spark workloads, SQL queries, and Fabric capacity utilization.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, Git integration, and deployment processes for Fabric artifacts.
* Work with Azure DevOps/GitHub to manage source code, releases, and development workflows.
* Implement appropriate data security, access controls, and workspace\-level governance.
* Collaborate with Power BI developers and analytics teams to provide optimized datasets and Semantic Models.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and ensure timely resolution.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design sessions, and solution walkthroughs.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level data engineers and promote data engineering best practices.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, reliability, security, and data quality standards.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**


* 6–8 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Development, or related data technology roles.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or strong experience in Azure data platforms with practical Fabric implementation experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.
* Expertise in Fabric Data Factory, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, and Data Warehouse.
* Strong experience with PySpark/Spark and Python for large\-scale data processing.
* Strong proficiency in SQL/T\-SQL and experience developing complex queries and transformations.
* Good understanding of Delta Lake and Medallion Architecture.
* Experience implementing Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT development and data integration patterns.
* Experience working with structured and semi\-structured data sources.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory and/or Azure Synapse Analytics is preferred.
* Experience with Power BI and Semantic Models is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of Direct Lake and Fabric performance optimization is preferred.
* Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and Fabric deployment pipelines.
* Good understanding of data security, access controls, data governance, and workspace management.
* Experience with data quality, monitoring, logging, and production support.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as lead and mentor technical team members.

What You Will Do


As a Lead Fabric Data Engineer, you will play a key role in building and modernizing enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric. You will work on challenging data engineering problems, develop scalable cloud data solutions, and contribute to the successful delivery of modern analytics capabilities for our clients.

* Define and implement Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and enterprise data modeling standards.
* Establish domain\-driven data ownership and governance aligned with Data Mesh principles.

* Monitor and optimize Fabric capacity, compute consumption, and platform costs.
* Act as a strategic advisor to senior business and client stakeholders, translating business requirements into scalable data and analytics solutions.
* Lead and mentor cross\-functional teams comprising Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, BI Developers, and Architects.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the data engineering lifecycle.
* Ensure successful delivery of multi\-phase enterprise data transformation initiatives within agreed timelines and quality standards.

* 10–14 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Enterprise Data Strategy.
* 1\.5–2\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and implementing Microsoft Fabric solutions.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.

You will play a key role in shaping and delivering modern enterprise data solutions, helping organizations unlock the value of their data through Microsoft Fabric, cloud modernization, data governance, and advanced analytics.
